title: Shop for Sat 28 Nov
note: Prices checked on Ocado tonight (Mon 23 Nov). 6 dinners: Sunday roast, fish night, veggie night, beef chilli, chicken burgers and a Thai curry night. No salmon this week after two weeks running.

options.deal: £20 Family Roast Meal Deal: £26.55 normally, so £6.55 off (25%)

goodValue.name: Charlie Bigham's Thai red chicken curry & rice x2
goodValue.value: £4.90 off for the two (25%): the same deal price you paid for the cottage pie on 21 Nov
goodValue.why: Two packs feed all four of you, and it's a different dinner from anything in recent weeks. Straight in the oven, so it's a good busy-night meal.

goodValue.name: Cathedral City mature cheddar 550g
goodValue.value: 27% off the normal price. Same as you paid on 21 Nov, so stock up rather than a new saving
goodValue.why: It goes into wraps, toasties and the chilli, and it keeps for weeks.

goodValue.name: Ocado 8 British pork sausages (swap)
goodValue.value: About half the price per sausage of the M&S Heritage Gold ones you had on 15 Nov (£3.50 a pack)
goodValue.why: A cheap swap to try for sausage & mash or a breakfast. If they're not as good, we go back to the M&S ones.

goodValue.name: BOL power soups x2
goodValue.value: £2.50 each instead of £3.50. Same as you paid last time
goodValue.why: Easy lunches you buy most weeks. Only worth it while the multibuy is on.

forYou.name: Ocado ripe & ready Conference pears (4)
forYou.why: British Conference pears are at their best now. A change from apples and grapes in lunchboxes.

forYou.name: Ocado British leeks 500g
forYou.value: Seasonal Stars: £1.10, was £1.39, same as you paid on 7 Nov
forYou.why: Good in the pies, the traybake or a leek & potato soup for 4 for about £3.
